text:
maria.k: Quick q — final pass on relnotes formatting before we merge? PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1248 — needs snippet checks, a Known Issues entry for the embed streaming change, and frontmatter tags for release-notes/changelog. Can someone do a sweep? :pray:

denise: I can do the snippet sweep. Will check Node/Python examples and hunt for broken links.

alex: I spotted inconsistent frontmatter across a couple entries — we should standardize to `release` and `category`. Also the doc TOC job flakes when there are empty H2s (seen on mobile). Quick suggested frontmatter:
```
---
release: '2026-03-19'
category: 'changelog'
---
```

denise: thanks — can you paste that in a comment on the PR so I can copy it into the files?

alex: done — just pushed a review comment on #1248 with the snippet. Also flagged one SDK snippet that still uses the old streaming callback signature `onData` instead of `on_close`.

maria.k: assigning @denise to own the snippets + linkcheck, @alex to frontmatter and mobile TOC tweak. Also add a short Known Issues blurb: "embed stream can drop final token if connection resets; workaround: set streaming_buffer_ms to 50" — can we include that in the relnotes?

julian: :thumbsup: added the known-issue wording to the product ticket. One more ask from eng: update the streaming example to show `client.stream(...).on('close', ...)` pattern (so customers see handling on disconnect).

denise: will update code blocks and run the docs linkcheck and anchorcheck (locally then CI). ETA ~2h, I'll push fixes to the PR branch.

deploy-bot: deploy preview for PR #1248 is up: https://deploy.preview.redwood-inference.com/1248 — preview shows TOC collapse issue on mobile.

alex: I'll tweak CSS for mobile TOC (small patch) and re-run preview.

maria.k: perfect — if checks are green we'll merge by EOD. Tiny reminder: update docs/changelog/_index.md to include the new release id after merge. :white_check_mark:

denise: noted, will update changelog index as a follow-up commit after snippet fixes.
